mentions.name: Review My Interior
mentions.description: An online interior design service that critiques interiors, suggests improvements, and guides users through different stages of home renovation. It aims to prevent rework and help save money, and is currently offered free to collect feedback and improve the product.
mentions.problem: Home renovation mistakes lead to costly rework; the service helps prevent rework and save money.
mentions.audience: People renovating their homes, currently free while the product collects feedback
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm a solo founder working on https://www.reviewmyinterior.com - Idea is to make an online interior designer who critiques, suggests and guides at different stages of home renovation. Hopefully, it should help prevent rework and thus help save money. Currently running as FRee product to collect feedback and improve the product.
